title: Rava bar Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Sukkah 34a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.34a.14) after Abaye; in [Shabbat 36a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.36a.6) the statement is attributed to Rav Ashi (Hyman proposes Rava without a patronymic).

In [Bava Metzia 67a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.67a.12) he speaks in Rava’s name according to Hyman’s report of the Rosh’s reading; the Gemara reads “Mar son of Rav Yosef in Rava’s name.”[^1]

notes.text: Sukkah names Rava bar Yosef in the Bavel–Borsif saying. Shabbat gives Rav Ashi in the parallel. The consulted Bava Metzia names Mar son of Rav Yosef as the one transmitting Rava’s ruling.
